sources.title: Frederick L. Hovde Hall of Administration, Purdue University 2016 01
sources.provider: Wikimedia Commons; photograph by Julian Herzog
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (as listed on Wikimedia Commons file page)
sources.use: Direct visual evidence for the six-column central portico, broad stairs, pediment, brick wings, red tile roof, and entrance rhythm. The near-frontal image supports a rough image ratio only; it is not a measured elevation.
sources.measurement: Approximate pixel ratio between pediment width and visible long facade; estimated ratio about 0.25 with +/-0.04 image and perspective uncertainty.
sources.limits: Trees obscure portions of the lower facade; perspective, lens, and image framing introduce uncertainty. No elevation dimensions were derived from pixels.

sources.title: Edward C. Elliott Hall of Music
sources.provider: Society of Architectural Historians, SAH Archipedia
sources.use: Describes Hovde's monumental steps, limestone portico, and formal lobby in its connection with Elliott Hall; also describes the Scholer campus material palette of red brick, Indiana limestone, and red clay tile roof.
sources.limits: Contextual evidence from the related Elliott Hall history, not a Hovde-specific roof survey or elevation.

round_9_changes: Restored the two missing support assemblies and reinstated the six columns clearly documented in the 2016 near-frontal photograph.
Redistributed six supports evenly across the portico width and increased column diameters modestly.

Adjusted the portico head width to approximately 17.9 m, using the visual ratio estimate against the Archives-reported 70 by 230 foot building dimensions. This is an estimate, not a surveyed dimension.
Added slight tympanum depth, subtle lighter limestone trim material, lower brick color contrast, and lighter blue-gray glazing tone.
not_verified_here: Master GIS feature alignment and neighboring building/entrance context; coordinator-owned task.
Exact portico dimension and column spacing; image-derived estimates only.
